tools.name: search_stays
tools.description: Search Vacations At Destin's 27 condos in Destin, Fort Walton Beach and Miramar Beach, Florida for the given dates and party size. Returns the condos available for the whole stay. Prices are not included here — call check_availability for one condo's exact final total.

tools.name: get_property
tools.description: Full details of one Vacations At Destin condo: description, bed configuration, amenities, view, resort and address, check-in/check-out times, stay rules and what is provided for guests. Identify the condo by property_id (from search_stays) or by its exact public name.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Live availability and the EXACT total price for one condo and dates, straight from the owner's booking system. The total is the final direct-booking total — rent, fees and taxes, with the automatic 10% direct-booking discount already applied. Nothing is booked or held by checking.

tools.name: request_booking
tools.description: Send a booking REQUEST for one condo to Vacations At Destin. This does NOT charge the guest and does NOT confirm the stay: the owner reviews the request and emails the guest to confirm and arrange payment directly. Only call this after the guest has confirmed the condo, the dates and the party, and

tools.name: booking_status
tools.description: Status of a booking request previously sent with request_booking, by its request id (for example VAD-AB12CD).
